neighbours.label: A frame reporting a measured finding, just before or at the quantity ('supports this, finding that', 'a survey indicates that 69', 'in 95% of'); ' that' and numbers in plain talk stay low.
fire: A new poll suggests that 54 percent of parents agree.
The trial eased pain in 88% of the women tested.
Data from the agency back this up, showing that 40 percent of teens read less.
An audit of the top firms reveals that most of them overpay.
Our review, finding that seven of 12 clinics failed, was published.
The authors report that 61 percent of mice survived.
Rates fell in 72% of the districts studied.
A national survey concludes that half of drivers speed.
quiet: A new neighbor suggests that we move the fence.
The trial ended in June with the women tested.
Friends from the agency back the plan, saying that teens like it.
An uncle of the two boys says that most of them snore.
Our dog, chasing seven of the ducks, was tired.
The authors said that the mice were kept in cages.
Rain fell in the morning on the district fair.
A national hero concludes that half the speech was weak.

notes: Probes: 0.11-0.34, uneven, so the median is at risk. 'He reveals that he likes' 0.01, 'near seven of his friends' 0.02. On this pole the output direction suppresses ' some', ' sometimes', ' occasionally'.
